types.name: TextProcessor
types.summary: Processes Unicode text through script analysis, BiDi reordering, shaping, and layout.
types.remarks: [[TextProcessor]] is the main entry point for the text processing pipeline. It orchestrates multiple Unicode algorithms to produce correctly shaped and positioned glyphs. Processing pipeline: Parsing — converts UTF-16 to codepoints Script analysis (UAX #24) — identifies script per codepoint BiDi algorithm (UAX #9) — determines text direction and reordering Itemization — splits text into runs by script, direction, and font Shaping — converts codepoints to positioned glyphs via HarfBuzz Line breaking (UAX #14) — determines line break opportunities Layout — positions glyphs according to alignment settings Performance: The processor caches intermediate results. Use invalidation methods only when necessary to avoid redundant processing.

types.name: UniTextArrayPool<T>
types.summary: High-performance array pool with thread-local caching and shared overflow storage.
types.remarks: This pool uses a two-tier caching strategy: Thread-local cache: One array per bucket per thread for instant access Shared buckets: Concurrent queues for cross-thread array sharing Arrays are organized into buckets by size (powers of 2 starting at 32). Supported sizes: 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536. Arrays larger than 65536 are allocated directly without pooling. Usage pattern: var array = UniTextArrayPool<int>.Rent(100); // Gets array of size 128 try { // Use array... } finally { UniTextArrayPool<int>.Return(array); }

typeParameters.name: T
typeParameters.description: The element type of arrays managed by this pool.

methods.name: Rent
methods.summary: Rents an array from the pool with at least the specified length.
methods.remarks: The returned array may contain data from previous use. Clear it if needed. Always call [[Return]] when done to avoid memory leaks.
methods.returns: An array with length greater than or equal to minimumLength. The actual length will be the next power of 2 bucket size.

methods.name: Return
methods.summary: Returns an array to the pool for reuse.
methods.remarks: Only arrays with sizes matching bucket sizes (32, 64, 128, etc.) are accepted. Arrays larger than max bucket size or with non-matching sizes are silently discarded. The array is not cleared before storage. Sensitive data should be cleared manually.

params.name: array
params.description: The array to return. Can be (no-op).

methods.name: GrowDouble
methods.summary: Doubles the capacity of a pooled array when count has reached the current capacity. Copies existing elements, returns the old array to the pool, and updates the reference.

methods.name: Clear
methods.summary: Clears all pooled arrays from both thread-local and shared storage.
methods.remarks: Call this to release memory when the pool is no longer needed, such as during scene transitions or application shutdown.

methods.name: ResetStats
methods.summary: Resets all statistics counters for this pool type.

methods.name: LogStats
methods.summary: Logs pool statistics to the Unity console and resets per-period counters.
methods.remarks: Shows rent/return counts, hit rates, and any rejected returns. Called automatically by [[LogAll]].

methods.name: GetStats
methods.summary: Gets a detailed string report of pool state including per-bucket counts.
methods.returns: A formatted string showing thread-local and shared counts per bucket size.

types.name: UniTextMeshGenerator
types.summary: Converts positioned glyphs into Unity mesh data for text rendering.
types.remarks: This is the final stage of the text processing pipeline. It takes [[PositionedGlyph]] data from [[TextProcessor]] and generates vertex, UV, color, and triangle data suitable for Unity's mesh system. Key features: Groups glyphs by rendering target to minimize draw calls: one segment per font (Texture2DArray atlas) Uses pooled buffers from [[UniTextArrayPool{T}]] for zero allocations Provides callbacks for text modifiers to inject custom processing Typical usage: generator.SetRectOffset(rect); generator.GenerateMeshDataOnly(positionedGlyphs); var renderData = generator.ApplyMeshesToUnity(meshProvider); // Use renderData to render each segment generator.ReturnInstanceBuffers();

types.name: UniTextFont
types.summary: Font asset containing glyph data, metrics, and texture atlases for text rendering.
types.remarks: UniTextFont is a ScriptableObject that stores: Font file data (TTF/OTF bytes) for FreeType rendering Face information (metrics, ascender, descender) Glyph table with metrics for text layout Glyph curve cache for SDF rendering Glyph curves are extracted at runtime when first needed and stored in a shared curve atlas.

methods.name: GetCachedInstanceId
methods.summary: Gets the cached Unity instance ID, initializing on first access.
methods.returns: The font asset's instance ID for use as a dictionary key.

methods.name: ComputeFontDataHash
methods.summary: Computes a hash of font file data for identification.
methods.returns: Hash value, or 0 if data is null/empty.

methods.name: ReadFontAssetDefinition
methods.summary: Initializes lookup dictionaries from serialized glyph and character tables.

methods.name: EnsureFTFace
methods.summary: Ensures a FreeType face handle is loaded for this font asset.
methods.returns: FT_Face handle, or IntPtr.Zero if loading failed.

methods.name: ReleaseFTFace
methods.summary: Releases the FreeType face handle if loaded.

methods.name: LoadFontFace
methods.summary: Loads the font face for glyph operations.
methods.returns: Success if the font was loaded, error code otherwise.

methods.name: GetGlyphIndexForUnicode
methods.summary: Gets the glyph index for a Unicode codepoint.
methods.returns: Glyph index, or 0 if the glyph is not available.

methods.name: RegisterCharacterEntries
methods.summary: Registers character-to-glyph mappings for later lookup.

methods.name: FilterNewGlyphs
methods.summary: Filters glyph indices, removing zeros and already-known glyphs. Returns a reusable list of unique indices to add, or null if nothing to add.

methods.name: HasGlyphInAtlas
methods.summary: Checks if a glyph is already cached (curve data extracted or bitmap rendered).

methods.name: CreateFontAsset
methods.summary: Creates a new font asset from raw font file bytes.
methods.returns: New font asset, or null if creation failed.

params.name: fontBytes
params.description: TTF or OTF font file data.

methods.name: ClearDynamicData
methods.summary: Clears all dynamically generated glyph data and resets atlas textures.
methods.remarks: Call this to force re-rendering of all glyphs. Useful when changing atlas parameters or for reducing memory usage.

methods.name: ClearRuntimeData
methods.summary: Clears dynamic data for all loaded font assets and invalidates shared caches.

properties.name: IsVariable
properties.summary: True if this font has any variable font axes.

properties.name: FontData
properties.summary: Gets the raw font file data (TTF/OTF bytes). Decompresses from Zstd on first access.

properties.name: ItalicStyle
properties.summary: Gets the italic slant angle in degrees.

properties.name: FontDataHash
properties.summary: Gets the hash of the font data for identification.

properties.name: HasFontData
properties.summary: Returns true if font file data is available.

properties.name: FaceInfo
properties.summary: Gets or sets the font face information (metrics, ascender, descender, etc.).

properties.name: UnitsPerEm
properties.summary: Gets or sets the font design units per em (typically 1000 or 2048).
properties.remarks: This is the fundamental scaling unit for font metrics. All glyph measurements are expressed relative to this value. Industry standard values are 1000 (CFF/OTF) or 2048 (TrueType). Used for correct scaling: scale = fontSize / unitsPerEm.

properties.name: FontScale
properties.summary: Visual scale multiplier for this font asset.
properties.remarks: Use to normalize fonts that appear too small or too large by design. For example, Dongle font renders visually smaller than other fonts at the same size — setting FontScale to 1.5 compensates for this. Applied as a post-conversion multiplier in all fontSize/UnitsPerEm scaling calculations.

properties.name: AtlasPadding
properties.summary: Gets the padding between glyphs in the atlas (EmojiFont only).

properties.name: GlyphLookupTable
properties.summary: Gets the glyph lookup table (glyph key → Glyph).

types.name: UniTextFontError
types.summary: Error codes for font loading operations.

types.name: UniTextFontProvider
types.summary: Manages font assets and provides font lookup services for text rendering.
types.remarks: The font provider handles: Primary font and fallback font resolution Font scaling based on requested font size Glyph caching in texture atlases Font data access (glyph lookup, font data bytes) Font family lookup for variant/variable font resolution Uses [[SharedFontCache]] for fast codepoint-to-font mapping.

methods.name: SetFontSize
methods.summary: Sets the font size in points.

methods.name: UniTextFontProvider
methods.summary: Initializes the font provider with the specified fonts.

params.name: fontStack
params.description: Font collection containing main and fallback fonts.

methods.name: GetFontId
methods.summary: Gets the unique font identifier for a font asset.
methods.returns: Font ID based on font data hash, or 0 if null.

methods.name: RegisterFontAsset
methods.summary: Registers a font asset with the provider.

methods.name: GetFontAsset
methods.summary: Gets a font asset by its identifier.
methods.returns: The font asset, or primary font if not found.

methods.name: GetLineMetrics
methods.summary: Gets line metrics scaled to the specified font size.

params.name: ascender
params.description: Output: distance from baseline to top of tallest glyph.

params.name: descender
params.description: Output: distance from baseline to bottom (typically negative).

methods.name: GetCapHeight
methods.summary: Gets the cap height (top of capital letters) scaled to the specified font size.
methods.returns: Scaled cap height, or 0 if unavailable.

methods.name: FindFontForCodepoint
methods.summary: Finds the best font to render a codepoint, using fallback chain if needed.
methods.returns: Font ID of the font that can render this codepoint.

params.name: codepoint
params.description: Unicode codepoint to find a font for.

methods.name: GetFamilyIndex
methods.summary: Gets the family index for a font ID. Returns 0 (first family) if not found.

methods.name: GetFontData
methods.summary: Gets the raw font data (TTF/OTF bytes) for a font.
methods.returns: Font file data, or null if not available.

properties.name: FontSize
properties.summary: Gets or sets the current font size in points.

properties.name: PrimaryFont
properties.summary: Gets the main (primary) font asset.

properties.name: PrinaryFontId
properties.summary: Gets the unique identifier for the primary font.

properties.name: HasFaces
properties.summary: Whether any family in the resolved chain has faces (variants or variable fonts).

types.name: UniTextFontStack
types.summary: ScriptableObject container for font families with fallback chain support.
types.remarks: Ordered list of font families. The first family's primary font is the primary font and provides strut metrics (line height, ascent, descent). Each family contains a primary font and optional faces (Bold, Italic, Variable, etc.). Face matching uses pre-computed lookup tables with CSS Fonts Level 4 §5.2 weight matching. Create via Assets menu: Create → UniText → Fonts

methods.name: FindFontForCodepoint
methods.summary: Finds a font that can render the specified Unicode codepoint.
methods.returns: Font that can render the codepoint, or null if none found.

params.name: unicode
params.description: Unicode codepoint to find a font for.

params.name: searched
params.description: Set of already-searched font IDs (to prevent loops).

properties.name: PrimaryFont
properties.summary: Gets the main (primary) font, or null if empty.

properties.name: HasFaces
properties.summary: Whether any family in this stack has faces (variants or variable fonts).

fields.summary: Ordered list of font families. First family's primary = MainFont (strut metrics).

fields.name: fallbackStack
fields.summary: Optional fallback stack. Searched after this stack's own families.

types.name: BaseLineModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that render horizontal lines across text (underline, strikethrough).
types.remarks: Subclasses define the vertical offset of the line relative to the baseline. The line automatically breaks across multiple lines and respects color changes.

types.name: BaseModifier
types.summary: Base class for all text modifiers that alter text appearance or behavior.
types.remarks: Modifiers are applied to text ranges via markup tags parsed by [[IParseRule]] implementations and can modify glyph rendering, colors, animations, or other properties. Lifecycle: [[SetOwner]] is called when the modifier is attached to UniText (sets references only) [[Apply]] is called for each text range - lazy initialization on first call [[Disable]] is called when text changes [[Destroy]] is called when the modifier is removed

methods.name: Prepare
methods.summary: Prepares the modifier for a new text cycle. Creates buffers and clears them. Called once before Apply pass.

methods.name: Apply
methods.summary: Applies the modifier to a text range. Requires Prepare() to be called first.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Parameter from the tag (e.g., color value).

methods.name: SetOwner
methods.summary: Sets the owner UniText reference. Does NOT initialize buffers or subscribe to events.

params.name: uniText
params.description: The UniText component to attach to.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.summary: Deinitializes the modifier and releases resources.

methods.name: Disable
methods.summary: Resets the modifier state for new text. Unsubscribes from events - will re-subscribe on next Apply().

methods.name: PrepareForParallel
methods.summary: Called on the main thread before parallel processing begins. Override to cache values from Unity APIs that are main-thread-only (e.g., Material.GetFloat).

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.summary: Subscribes to UniText events. Override to set up buffers and event handlers.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.summary: Unsubscribes from UniText events. Override to remove event handlers.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.summary: Releases buffers when the modifier is removed. Override to clean up resources.

methods.name: OnApply
methods.summary: Implements the modifier's effect on the specified range.

properties.name: IsInitialized
properties.summary: Returns true if this modifier has been initialized (Apply called at least once).

fields.name: uniText
fields.summary: Reference to the UniText component this modifier is attached to.

fields.name: buffers
fields.summary: Access to text processing buffers.

types.name: BoldModifier
types.summary: Applies bold styling to text using CSS font-weight scale (100-900).
types.remarks: Parameter: optional CSS font-weight (100-900). Without parameter, computes max(700, baseWeight + 300). When used with font variants (static or variable), ResolveVariants selects the appropriate real font and clears the bold buffer. When no variant is available, BoldModifier applies fake bold via SDF shader dilate (UV1.y) and advance correction. Encoding: byte buffer per codepoint. 0 = not bold, 1-255 = CSS weight mapped to byte range.

types.name: ColorModifier
types.summary: Applies color to text ranges using hex codes or named colors.
types.remarks: Parameter: a color value in hex or by name. Supported formats: - Hex: #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA - Named colors: white, black, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, orange, purple, gray, lime, brown, pink, navy, teal, olive, maroon, silver, gold The alpha channel from the color parameter is preserved. The base alpha is inherited from the component's color.

methods.name: TryGetColor
methods.summary: Tries to get the custom color for a cluster from the specified buffers.
methods.returns: True if a custom color exists for the cluster; otherwise, false.

params.name: buffers
params.description: The UniText buffers containing color attribute data.

params.name: cluster
params.description: The cluster index to look up.

types.name: ColorParsing
types.summary: Shared color parsing utilities for modifiers that accept color parameters. Supports hex (#RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA) and named colors.

types.name: CompositeModifier
types.summary: Combines multiple modifiers into a single modifier.
types.remarks: Splits the tag parameter by; and passes each segment to the corresponding child modifier. For example, <wobble-color=3,10,1;#FF0000> passes "3,10,1" to the first modifier and "#FF0000" to the second. Child modifiers with no corresponding segment (fewer; groups than modifiers) receive a null parameter and fall back to their defaults.

fields.name: modifiers
fields.summary: Child modifiers to apply in order.

types.name: EffectModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that render an additional effect pass behind the face (outline, shadow, glow).
types.remarks: Each instance registers an [[EffectPass]] on the generator. The system iterates these passes to create per-modifier CanvasRenderers without any knowledge of what the effect does. Subclasses override [[OnGlyphEffect]] to record per-glyph effect data and [[OnApply]] to collect text ranges.

methods.name: OnGlyphEffect
methods.summary: Called for each glyph during mesh generation. Subclass should check cluster ranges and call [[RecordEffectGlyph]] for matching glyphs.

methods.name: HasVertexShifts
methods.summary: Returns true if this effect type can shift vertex positions (shadow with offset).

methods.name: RecordEffectGlyph
methods.summary: Records a glyph for this effect and reports required padding extent to the generator.

fields.name: effectGlyphs
fields.summary: Recorded per-glyph effect data. Populated during OnGlyph, consumed by apply/revert.

types.name: EffectPacking
types.summary: Utility methods for packing effect layer parameters into vertex UV channels.
types.remarks: Used by effect modifiers to encode per-glyph layer parameters (color, offsets) into float UV values that are unpacked in the shader. Packing formats: [[PackColor]]: Color32 RGBA → uint → float (bit-reinterpret)

methods.name: PackColor
methods.summary: Packs a Color32 into a single float via bit reinterpretation.
methods.remarks: Layout: R in bits 24–31, G in 16–23, B in 8–15, A in 0–7. Unpacked in shader with asuint and bit shifts.
methods.returns: A float whose bits represent the packed RGBA bytes.

types.name: EffectPass
types.summary: Describes a single effect render pass that modifies generator buffers before mesh upload.
types.remarks: Registered by subscribers via [[effectPasses]]. The system calls [[apply]] before mesh upload and [[revert]] after, without knowledge of what the callbacks do internally.

fields.name: apply
fields.summary: Writes effect data (UV2, vertex shifts) into generator buffers.

fields.name: revert
fields.summary: Reverts effect data (clears UV2, restores vertices) in generator buffers.

fields.name: hasVertexShifts
fields.summary: When true, the pass modifies vertex positions (requires SetVertices re-upload).

types.name: EllipsisModifier
types.summary: Truncates text that overflows its container and appends an ellipsis (...).
types.remarks: Parameter: optional position (0-1) controlling where the ellipsis appears: - 0: Truncates from the start, ellipsis at the beginning - 0.5: Truncates from the middle, ellipsis in the center - 1 (default): Truncates from the end, ellipsis at the end The modifier automatically detects overflow based on container height (with word wrap) or width (without word wrap) and uses binary search to find the optimal truncation point.

types.name: EmptyModifier
types.summary: A no-op modifier that performs no action.
types.remarks: Used as a placeholder or for tags that should be parsed but have no visual effect. Can be associated with custom parse rules to extract data without modifying rendering.

types.name: GlyphModifier<T>
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that store per-glyph attribute data.
types.remarks: GlyphModifier provides automatic buffer management for per-glyph attributes. Derived classes implement [[GetOnGlyphCallback]] to receive callbacks during mesh generation, where they can modify vertex data based on attribute values. Optionally override [[GetOnShapedCallback]] to also receive a callback after shaping completes, for modifying glyph advances or run widths.

methods.name: OnApply
methods.summary: Called by BaseModifier.Apply(). Delegates to DoApply.

methods.name: DoApply
methods.summary: Implements the modifier's effect on the specified range. Buffer is guaranteed to have sufficient capacity when this is called.

methods.name: GetOnGlyphCallback
methods.summary: Returns the callback to invoke during glyph mesh generation.

methods.name: GetOnShapedCallback
methods.summary: Returns a callback to invoke after shaping completes. Override to modify glyph advances or run widths. Returns null by default (no shaped callback).

properties.name: AttributeKey
properties.summary: Gets the unique key for this attribute in the buffer system.

fields.name: attribute
fields.summary: The pooled attribute array for per-glyph data.

types.name: GradientModifier
types.summary: Applies gradient coloring to text ranges using named gradients.
types.remarks: Parameter format: name[,shape][,angle] rainbow — linear gradient, angle 0 rainbow,linear,45 — linear at 45° rainbow,radial — radial gradient from center rainbow,angular — angular (conic) sweep from top rainbow,angular,90 — angular sweep rotated 90° Shape controls the gradient form: linear (projection onto an axis), radial (distance from center), or angular (conic sweep). Gradients are defined in [[UniTextGradients]] ScriptableObject referenced by [[UniTextSettings]].

types.name: IAttributeData
types.summary: Interface for custom attribute data stored in [[UniTextBuffers]].
types.remarks: Implement this interface to create custom per-text attribute storage for modifiers. Use [[GetOrCreateAttributeData{T}]] to retrieve instances.

methods.name: Release
methods.summary: Releases all pooled resources back to the pool.

types.name: InlineObject
types.summary: Defines an inline object that can be embedded within text flow.
types.remarks: Inline objects are referenced by name in the text and rendered as UI prefabs that flow with the text like characters. All metrics are in em units (relative to fontSize): width=1, height=1 means the object is fontSize x fontSize pixels advance=1 means the cursor moves by fontSize pixels after this object bearingX/Y are offsets relative to fontSize

fields.name: width
fields.summary: Width in em units (1 = fontSize).

fields.name: height
fields.summary: Height in em units (1 = fontSize).

fields.name: bearingX
fields.summary: Horizontal offset in em units.

fields.name: bearingY
fields.summary: Vertical offset in em units.

fields.name: advance
fields.summary: Advance width in em units (1 = fontSize).

types.name: InteractiveModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that create interactive (clickable/hoverable) text ranges.
types.remarks: Inherit from this class to create custom interactive modifiers like links, hashtags, mentions, or any other clickable text elements. This class automatically: Registers/unregisters with [[InteractiveRangeRegistry]] Stores ranges in a [[PooledArrayAttribute{T}]] Delegates click/hover events to subclass implementations

methods.name: AddRange
methods.summary: Adds an interactive range for the specified text region.

methods.name: HandleRangeClicked
methods.summary: Called when the user clicks on a range owned by this modifier.

methods.name: HandleRangeEntered
methods.summary: Called when the pointer enters a range owned by this modifier (desktop only).

methods.name: HandleRangeExited
methods.summary: Called when the pointer exits a range owned by this modifier (desktop only).

properties.name: Highlighter
properties.summary: Gets or sets the per-modifier text highlighter. When null, the global UniText highlighter is used as fallback.

properties.name: RangeType
properties.summary: Gets the type identifier for ranges created by this modifier.

properties.name: Priority
properties.summary: Gets the priority for overlap resolution. Higher values win.

properties.name: AttributeKey
properties.summary: Gets the attribute key for storing ranges.

types.name: ItalicModifier
types.summary: Applies italic styling to text by shearing glyph vertices.
types.remarks: No parameter. The italic effect is achieved by horizontally shearing the glyph vertices. The shear angle is determined by the font's ItalicStyle property (default 12 degrees).

types.name: LetterSpacingModifier
types.summary: Applies character spacing (tracking) adjustments to text ranges.
types.remarks: Parameter: spacing value with unit. 10 — add 10 pixels between characters -5 — reduce spacing by 5 pixels 0.5em — add 0.5 em (relative to font size) For cursive joining scripts (Arabic, Syriac, N'Ko, Adlam, etc.), visual kashida (tatweel) bars are rendered between connected letter pairs using 9-slice SDF rendering, preserving the appearance of cursive connections at any spacing value.

types.name: LineHeightModifier
types.summary: Adjusts line height/spacing for text ranges.
types.remarks: Parameter: line height or spacing value. 1.5 — 150% of default line height (multiplier) 40 — absolute 40 pixels +10 — add 10 pixels to default (delta) -5 — reduce by 5 pixels (delta)

types.name: LinkModifier
types.summary: Modifier that creates clickable hyperlinks in text.
types.remarks: Applies link styling (color and optional underline) to text ranges and handles click events. Parameter: URL string. Subscribe to [[LinkClicked]] to handle link clicks, or let the modifier open URLs automatically via [[OpenURL]].
types.example:
var linkMod = uniText.GetModifier<LinkModifier>();
linkMod.LinkClicked += url => Debug.Log($"Link clicked: {url}");

properties.name: LinkColor
properties.summary: Gets or sets the color applied to link text.

properties.name: EnableUnderline
properties.summary: Gets or sets whether underline decoration is enabled.

properties.name: AutoOpenUrl
properties.summary: Gets or sets whether URLs are opened automatically on click.

events.name: LinkClicked
events.summary: Raised when a link is clicked, providing the URL.

events.name: LinkEntered
events.summary: Raised when the pointer enters a link, providing the URL.

events.name: LinkExited
events.summary: Raised when the pointer exits a link.

types.name: ListItemInfo
types.summary: Contains information about a single list item for rendering.

types.name: ListModifier
types.summary: Renders list markers (bullets or numbers) for text items with automatic indentation.
types.remarks: Parameter: optional level:number for numbered lists. Without parameter, renders a bullet. Features: - Supports nested lists with configurable indentation per level - Bullet markers are customizable per nesting level - Ordered lists support decimal, alphabetic, and Roman numeral styles - Automatically handles RTL text direction

fields.name: indentPerLevel
fields.summary: Indent per nesting level in em units (e.g., 0.55 = 0.55em).

types.name: LowercaseModifier
types.summary: Transforms text to lowercase within marked ranges.
types.remarks: No parameter. The transformation happens during Apply, after parsing but before shaping, ensuring correct glyph rendering for lowercase characters.

types.name: ModifierBufferExtensions
types.summary: Extension methods for working with modifier attribute buffers.

methods.name: HasFlag
methods.summary: Checks if a byte flag is set at the specified index.

methods.name: HasAnyFlags
methods.summary: Checks if any flags are set in the buffer.

methods.name: SetFlagRange
methods.summary: Sets byte flags for a range of indices.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.summary: Checks if a uint value is non-zero at the specified index.

methods.name: GetValueOrDefault
methods.summary: Gets a uint value or returns 0 if out of bounds.

methods.name: SetValueRange
methods.summary: Sets uint values for a range of indices.

types.name: ObjModifier
types.summary: Embeds UI prefabs (images, icons, custom elements) inline with text.
types.remarks: Parameter: the name of the object to embed (must match an entry in the [[objects]] list). The modifier replaces placeholder text with instantiated prefabs positioned in the text flow. Objects are defined in the [[objects]] list and referenced by name in the tag parameter. All metrics are in em units (relative to fontSize). With width=1, height=1 the object will be fontSize x fontSize pixels, matching the size of a typical character.

types.name: OrderedMarkerStyle
types.summary: Specifies the numbering style for ordered list markers.

fields.name: Decimal
fields.summary: Decimal numbers (1, 2, 3...)

fields.name: LowerAlpha
fields.summary: Lowercase letters (a, b, c...)

fields.name: UpperAlpha
fields.summary: Uppercase letters (A, B, C...)

fields.name: LowerRoman
fields.summary: Lowercase Roman numerals (i, ii, iii...)

fields.name: UpperRoman
fields.summary: Uppercase Roman numerals (I, II, III...)

types.name: OutlineModifier
types.summary: Applies an outline effect via a dedicated Base-pass CanvasRenderer.
types.remarks: All parameters come from the tag/rule parameter string. Format: <outline=dilate>, <outline=#color>, or <outline=dilate,#color>. Defaults: dilate = 0.2, color = black (#000000FF).

fields.name: fixedPixelSize
fields.summary: When true, dilate is in fixed pixels and compensated by gradientScale per glyph.

types.name: ParsedRange
types.summary: Represents a parsed text range with associated tag information.
types.remarks: Used by [[IParseRule]] implementations to communicate which text regions should be affected by modifiers and where tags should be stripped.

methods.name: ParsedRange
methods.summary: Creates a simple range without tag information.

methods.name: ParsedRange
methods.summary: Creates a range with opening and closing tag positions.

methods.name: SelfClosing
methods.summary: Creates a self-closing tag range that inserts content.

properties.name: HasTags
properties.summary: Returns true if this range has associated tags.

properties.name: IsSelfClosing
properties.summary: Returns true if this is a self-closing tag with inserted content.

fields.name: start
fields.summary: Start index of the content (after opening tag).

fields.name: end
fields.summary: End index of the content (before closing tag).

fields.name: tagStart
fields.summary: Start index of the opening tag, or -1 if no tag.

fields.name: tagEnd
fields.summary: End index of the opening tag.

fields.name: closeTagStart
fields.summary: Start index of the closing tag.

fields.name: closeTagEnd
fields.summary: End index of the closing tag.

fields.name: parameter
fields.summary: Parameter extracted from the tag (e.g., color value).

fields.name: insertString
fields.summary: String to insert for self-closing tags.

types.name: ScriptPositionModifier
types.summary: Applies superscript or subscript formatting to text ranges.
types.remarks: Two-tier approach: Native: activates OpenType 'sups'/'subs' feature via HarfBuzz (proper glyphs). Synthesis: scales down and shifts vertically using OS/2 metrics (fallback). Attribute sbyte encoding: 0 = unchanged, +1 = native super, -1 = native sub, +2 = synth super, -2 = synth sub. Create two styles to support both tags: Style 1: ScriptPositionModifier + TagRule("sup") with defaultParameter = "super" Style 2: ScriptPositionModifier + TagRule("sub") with defaultParameter = "sub"

types.name: ShadowModifier
types.summary: Applies a shadow effect via a dedicated Base-pass CanvasRenderer.
types.remarks: Shadow offset is applied via mesh vertex displacement. Each instance gets its own CanvasRenderer, enabling unlimited stacking of shadow/outline effects. All parameters come from the tag/rule parameter string. Format: <shadow=#color>, <shadow=dilate,#color>, or <shadow=dilate,#color,offsetX,offsetY,softness>. Defaults: dilate = 0, color = black 50% (#00000080), offset = (0.1,-0.1), softness = 0.1.

fields.name: fixedPixelSize
fields.summary: When true, dilate/offset/softness are in fixed pixels and compensated by gradientScale per glyph.

types.name: SizeModifier
types.summary: Applies font size changes to text ranges.
types.remarks: Parameter: size value with optional unit. 24 — absolute size in pixels 150% — percentage of base font size +10 — relative increase in pixels -5 — relative decrease in pixels

types.name: SmallCapsModifier
types.summary: Renders lowercase letters as small capitals.
types.remarks: Two-tier approach: Native: activates OpenType 'smcp' feature via HarfBuzz (proper small cap glyphs). Synthesis: converts lowercase to uppercase and scales down (fallback for fonts without smcp). Attribute byte encoding: 0 = unchanged, 1 = native smcp, 2 = synthesis.

types.name: StrikethroughModifier
types.summary: Renders a horizontal line through the middle of the text (strikethrough effect).
types.remarks: No parameter. The line position is determined by the font's strikethroughOffset property, or calculated from the x-height if not available. Supports line breaks and color inheritance from the text.

types.name: Style
types.summary: Serializable container that links a modifier with its parse rule. Tracks registration state and ownership to prevent bugs.
types.remarks: Note: "Initialized" state (buffers created, events subscribed) is tracked by BaseModifier.IsInitialized and happens lazily on first Apply(). Ownership rules: - Style tracks its owner UniText - Registration fails if already registered to different owner - State resets on deserialization

properties.name: Modifier
properties.summary: Gets or sets the modifier, with proper lifecycle management on hot-swap.

properties.name: Rule
properties.summary: Gets or sets the parse rule, with proper lifecycle management on hot-swap.

properties.name: Owner
properties.summary: Gets the UniTextBase that owns this Style.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.summary: Returns true if both modifier and rule are assigned.

properties.name: IsRegistered
properties.summary: Returns true if registered to a UniText.

types.name: UnderlineModifier
types.summary: Renders an underline below text using the font's underline metrics.
types.remarks: No parameter. The underline position is determined by the font's underlineOffset property. Supports line breaks and color inheritance from the text.

types.name: UppercaseModifier
types.summary: Transforms text to uppercase within marked ranges.
types.remarks: No parameter. The transformation happens during Apply, after parsing but before shaping, ensuring correct glyph rendering for uppercase characters.

types.name: VariationModifier
types.summary: Controls variable font axis values per text range.
types.remarks: Parameter: positional axis values in order wght, wdth, ital, slnt, opsz. Use ~ to skip an axis. Each value supports absolute, percentage, or delta: 700 — absolute axis value 150% — percentage of font's default +200 — delta from font's default Examples: 700, ~,80, 700,~,~,-12

types.name: WobbleAnimationModifier
types.summary: Applies a sine-wave wobble animation to text by oscillating glyph vertices vertically.
types.remarks: Each glyph moves up and down based on sin(time * speed + cluster * spread) * amplitude. The modifier continuously triggers mesh rebuilds while active.

types.name: CompositeParseRule
types.summary: Combines multiple parse rules into a single rule.
types.remarks: Tries each child rule in order until one matches. Useful for grouping related rules or creating reusable rule sets.

fields.name: rules
fields.summary: Child rules to apply in order.

types.name: IParseRule
types.summary: Interface for custom text parsing rules that identify modifier application ranges.
types.remarks: Parse rules scan text for markup (XML tags, Markdown, custom markers) and produce [[ParsedRange]] entries that specify where modifiers should be applied. Rules are matched in priority order (highest first). Use higher priority for explicit markup rules (tags, Markdown) and lower priority for auto-detection rules (raw URLs).

methods.name: TryMatch
methods.summary: Attempts to match a pattern starting at the specified index.
methods.returns: Index after the match, or same index if no match.

params.name: results
params.description: List to add parsed ranges to.

methods.name: Finalize
methods.summary: Called after parsing completes to finalize any pending ranges (e.g., unclosed tags).

methods.name: PostParse
methods.summary: Called after tag stripping to add ranges in clean-text space.

methods.name: Reset
methods.summary: Resets the rule state for a new parse operation.

properties.name: Priority
properties.summary: Gets the matching priority. Higher values are matched first. Default is 0. Use positive values for explicit markup, negative for auto-detection.

types.name: MarkdownLinkParseRule
types.summary: Parses Markdown-style links: [link text](https://example.com).

types.name: MarkdownListParseRule
types.summary: Parses Markdown-style lists (bulleted and numbered).
types.remarks: Supports unordered lists with -, *, + markers and ordered lists with 1., 2) etc. Nested lists are detected by indentation level.

fields.name: spacesPerLevel
fields.summary: Number of spaces per indentation level for nested lists.

types.name: MarkdownWrapRule
types.summary: Parses symmetric open/close markers in text (e.g., **text**, ~~text~~).
types.remarks: The marker string is configurable — any string can be used as a marker with any modifier. When [[defaultParameter]] is set, matched ranges use it as the parameter value.

fields.name: marker
fields.summary: The symmetric marker string that wraps the affected text range.

types.name: RawUrlParseRule
types.summary: Auto-detects URLs in plain text and converts them to clickable links.
types.remarks: Recognizes schemes: http://, https://, ftp://, ftps://, file://, mailto:, tel:, and www. prefixes. Uses negative priority (-100) to run after explicit markup rules (tags, Markdown), so URLs inside other markup are not detected.

properties.name: Priority
properties.summary: Low priority ensures this runs after explicit markup rules.

types.name: StringParseRule
types.summary: Matches literal string patterns and optionally replaces them.
types.remarks: Useful for custom shortcodes, emoji aliases, or text substitutions. Example: pattern ":)" with replacement "😊".

fields.name: patterns
fields.summary: String patterns to match (case-sensitive).

fields.name: hasReplacement
fields.summary: Whether to replace matched patterns with a custom string.

fields.name: replacement
fields.summary: Replacement string (used when hasReplacement is true).

types.name: TagParseRule
types.summary: Base class for parsing XML-style markup tags (e.g., <b>, <color=#FF0000>).
types.remarks: Derived classes override [[TagName]] to specify the tag name to match. Parameters are always optional: <tag>, <tag=value>, <tag/>, <tag=value/>. Self-closing is purely syntax-driven via />.

properties.name: TagName
properties.summary: Gets the tag name to match (e.g., "b" for <b>).

types.name: TagRule
types.summary: Universal tag parse rule configured via a serialized tag name. Replaces all individual tag parse rule classes (BoldParseRule, ColorParseRule, etc.).
types.remarks: Parameters are always optional. Self-closing is syntax-driven via />. <tag>text</tag> — range with no parameter <tag=value>text</tag> — range with parameter <tag/> — self-closing, no parameter <tag=value/> — self-closing with parameter When [[defaultParameter]] is set, tags without parameters use it as a fallback. Tags with partial parameters merge with the default (tag values take priority).

types.name: ShapedGlyph
types.summary: Represents a shaped glyph with positioning information from the shaping engine.
types.remarks: Produced by [[Shaper]] after OpenType shaping. Contains the glyph ID, cluster mapping back to codepoints, and advance/offset values.

fields.name: glyphId
fields.summary: The font-specific glyph identifier.

fields.name: cluster
fields.summary: Absolute index into the codepoints array for the cluster that produced this glyph.

fields.name: advanceX
fields.summary: Horizontal advance to the next glyph position.

fields.name: advanceY
fields.summary: Vertical advance to the next glyph position.

fields.name: offsetX
fields.summary: Horizontal offset from the pen position for rendering.

fields.name: offsetY
fields.summary: Vertical offset from the pen position for rendering.

types.name: ShapedRun
types.summary: Represents a text run after shaping, with glyph information and metrics.

fields.name: range
fields.summary: The codepoint range covered by this run.

fields.name: glyphStart
fields.summary: Index of the first glyph in the shaped glyphs buffer.

fields.name: glyphCount
fields.summary: Number of glyphs in this run.

fields.name: width
fields.summary: Total width of all glyphs in this run.

fields.name: direction
fields.summary: The text direction of this run.

fields.name: bidiLevel
fields.summary: The BiDi embedding level.

fields.name: fontId
fields.summary: The font ID used for this run.

types.name: Shaper
types.summary: Text shaper that converts codepoints to positioned glyphs via HarfBuzz. Performs full OpenType shaping (GSUB/GPOS) including kerning, ligatures and mark positioning.

methods.name: GetGlyphIndex
methods.summary: Gets the glyph index for a codepoint in the specified font.
methods.returns: Glyph index, or 0 if not found.

methods.name: TryGetGlyphInfo
methods.summary: Gets glyph index and advance width for a codepoint.
methods.returns: True if the glyph was found.

params.name: advance
params.description: Output horizontal advance in font units.

methods.name: GetUnitsPerEm
methods.summary: Gets the units per em value for the font.
methods.returns: Units per em, typically 1000 or 2048.

methods.name: GetUpemFromFontData
methods.summary: Gets upem directly from font data without caching.

methods.name: ClearCache
methods.summary: Clears the shaping cache for a specific font asset.

params.name: fontAssetInstanceId
params.description: Instance ID of the font asset to clear.

methods.name: ClearAllCaches
methods.summary: Clears all shaping caches for all fonts.

methods.name: ComputeScale
methods.summary: Computes the glyph scale factor for a font.

properties.name: Instance
properties.summary: Gets the singleton shaper instance.

types.name: ShapingResult
types.summary: Result of a shaping operation containing glyphs and metrics.
types.remarks: This is a ref struct to allow returning a span without allocation.

methods.name: ShapingResult
methods.summary: Initializes a new instance of the [[ShapingResult]] struct.

fields.name: Glyphs
fields.summary: The shaped glyphs with positioning information.

fields.name: TotalAdvance
fields.summary: The total horizontal advance of all glyphs.

types.name: IWordSegmenter
types.summary: Interface for script-specific word segmenters that inject break opportunities into SA-class (Complex Context Dependent) text runs.
types.remarks: Implementations segment a contiguous run of codepoints belonging to a single script and write [[Optional]] at word boundaries. Register via [[Register]]. Registering a segmenter for a script that already has one replaces it.

methods.name: Segment
methods.summary: Segments a span of codepoints and injects Optional break opportunities at word boundaries.

params.name: codepoints
params.description: The full codepoint array of the text.

params.name: start
params.description: Start index of the SA run within codepoints.

params.name: breaks
params.description: Break opportunities array to modify (length = codepoints.Length + 1). breaks[i+1] represents the break opportunity between codepoints[i] and codepoints[i+1]. Must never downgrade an existing Optional or Mandatory break to None.

properties.name: Script
properties.summary: The Unicode script this segmenter handles.

types.name: LineBreakType
types.summary: Specifies the type of line break opportunity according to UAX #14.

fields.name: None
fields.summary: No break allowed at this position.

fields.name: Optional
fields.summary: Break is allowed but not required (soft break).

fields.name: Mandatory
fields.summary: Break is required at this position (hard break after CR, LF, etc.).

types.name: TextDirection
types.summary: Specifies the base text direction for bidirectional text processing.

fields.name: LeftToRight
fields.summary: Left-to-right direction (e.g., Latin, Cyrillic).

fields.name: RightToLeft
fields.summary: Right-to-left direction (e.g., Arabic, Hebrew).

fields.name: Auto
fields.summary: Automatically detect direction from text content using UAX #9.

types.name: UnicodeData
types.summary: Provides access to Unicode character properties and the global data provider.
types.remarks: Contains common Unicode codepoint constants (whitespace, control characters, BiDi marks) and helper methods for character classification. The static [[Provider]] property gives access to the full Unicode property database for script, line break, and grapheme cluster information.

methods.name: IsMandatoryBreakChar
methods.summary: Returns true if the codepoint is a line or paragraph separator that produces a mandatory break (UAX #14 classes BK, CR, LF, NL) and should not be shaped.

types.name: UnicodeScript
types.summary: Unicode Script property values (UAX #24).
types.remarks: Each codepoint belongs to exactly one script. Used by [[ScriptAnalyzer]] to segment text into runs of uniform script for shaping. Some scripts like [[Common]] (punctuation) and [[Inherited]] (combining marks) can appear in text of any script.

fields.name: Unknown
fields.summary: Script could not be determined.

fields.name: Common
fields.summary: Characters used in multiple scripts (punctuation, symbols).

fields.name: Inherited
fields.summary: Combining marks that inherit script from base character.

fields.name: Latin
fields.summary: Latin script (English, Spanish, French, etc.)

types.name: WordSegmentationDictionary
types.summary: Self-contained dictionary asset for word segmentation of a specific script.
types.remarks: Each asset holds a binary double-array trie and the target Unicode script. Add to UniText Settings to enable word segmentation for that script. Create via Tools → UniText → Tools → Dictionary Builder tab.

properties.name: Script
properties.summary: The Unicode script this dictionary targets.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.summary: Returns true if this dictionary contains valid trie data.

types.name: IndexEx
types.summary: Extension methods for parsing [[Index]] from string representation.
types.remarks: Supports C# index syntax: "0" for start-based, "^1" for end-based indices. Used internally for markup parameter parsing.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.summary: Parses a string into a [[Index]].
methods.returns: true if parsing succeeded; otherwise false.

types.name: PooledArrayAttribute<T>
types.summary: A pooled array-based implementation of [[IAttributeData]].
types.remarks: Use this class to store per-codepoint or per-glyph attribute data in modifiers. The underlying array is rented from [[UniTextArrayPool{T}]] for zero-allocation operation.

typeParameters.name: T
typeParameters.description: The type of elements stored in the array.

methods.name: Add
methods.summary: Adds an item to the end of the buffer.

methods.name: EnsureCountAndClear
methods.summary: Ensures the buffer has at least the specified capacity, clearing if newly allocated.

properties.name: Count
properties.summary: Gets the number of elements in the buffer.

fields.name: buffer
fields.summary: The underlying pooled buffer.

types.name: PooledBuffer<T>
types.summary: A value-type wrapper for managing a pooled array with count tracking.
types.remarks: Provides a List-like interface over a pooled array without heap allocations for the container itself. Use [[Rent]] to acquire an array and [[Return]] to release it back to the pool. The [[count]] field tracks how many elements are in use, while [[Capacity]] reflects the actual array length. Operations like [[Add]] automatically grow the buffer.

methods.name: Rent
methods.summary: Rents an array from the pool with the specified capacity. Returns any existing array to the pool first.

methods.name: Return
methods.summary: Returns the array to the pool and resets the buffer.

methods.name: FakeClear
methods.summary: Resets count to zero without clearing data or returning to pool.
methods.remarks: Fast reset for reuse when data clearing is not needed.

methods.name: Clear
methods.summary: Clears the used portion of the array and resets count to zero.

methods.name: ClearData
methods.summary: Clears the used portion of the array without resetting count.

methods.name: EnsureCapacity
methods.summary: Ensures the buffer has at least the specified capacity, growing if needed.

methods.name: EnsureCount
methods.summary: Ensures both capacity and count are at least the specified value.

methods.name: Add
methods.summary: Adds an item to the end of the buffer, growing if necessary.

methods.name: RemoveRange
methods.summary: Removes a range of elements from the buffer.

params.name: index
params.description: The starting index of elements to remove.

params.name: removeCount
params.description: The number of elements to remove.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.summary: Removes the element at the specified index, shifting subsequent elements.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the element to remove.

methods.name: Insert
methods.summary: Inserts an item at the specified index, shifting subsequent elements.

params.name: index
params.description: The index at which to insert.

methods.name: SwapRemoveAt
methods.summary: Removes the element at the specified index by swapping with the last element.
methods.remarks: O(1) removal but does not preserve order.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the element to remove.

methods.name: Sort
methods.summary: Sorts the used portion of the buffer using the specified comparison.

methods.name: Sort
methods.summary: Sorts a range of elements using the specified comparer.

params.name: index
params.description: The starting index of the range to sort.

params.name: length
params.description: The number of elements to sort.

properties.name: Capacity
properties.summary: Gets the capacity of the underlying array (0 if not rented).

properties.name: Span
properties.summary: Gets a span over the used portion of the buffer (0 to count).

fields.name: data
fields.summary: The underlying array. May be if not rented.

fields.name: count
fields.summary: The number of elements currently in use.

types.name: PooledList<T>
types.summary: A reference-type wrapper around [[PooledBuffer{T}]] for scenarios requiring heap allocation.
types.remarks: Use this when you need to store a pooled collection in a field or pass it by reference without boxing. The underlying [[buffer]] is a struct, so modifications are in-place. Provides the same API as [[PooledBuffer{T}]] but as a class for scenarios where value-type semantics are not suitable.

methods.name: PooledList
methods.summary: Initializes a new instance without renting an array.

methods.name: PooledList
methods.summary: Initializes a new instance and rents an array with the specified capacity.

properties.name: Count
properties.summary: Gets the number of elements in the list.

properties.name: Capacity
properties.summary: Gets the capacity of the underlying array.

fields.name: buffer
fields.summary: The underlying buffer storage.

types.name: RangeEx
types.summary: Extension methods for parsing [[Range]] from string representation.
types.remarks: Supports C# range syntax: "0..5", "..5", "2..", "^3..^1". Used internally for markup parameter parsing.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.summary: Parses a string into a [[Range]].
methods.returns: true if parsing succeeded; otherwise false.

methods.name: Range
methods.summary: Converts a [[Range]] to absolute start/end indices for a given length.
methods.returns: A tuple of (start, end) absolute indices.
